title: Velocity at incline bottom
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (1) must be correctly stated as 2√7 m/s or its decimal equivalent.

title: Distance on horizontal surface
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (2) must be correctly stated as 3.5 m.

title: Work-energy on incline
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem for the incline, equating net work to the change in kinetic energy.

title: Correct friction force
description: Important: The work done by friction on the incline must use the normal force mg cos(37°).

title: Work-energy on horizontal
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem on the horizontal surface, with friction doing negative work until the object stops.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All quantities should be expressed with correct SI units throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the work done by friction is given a positive sign instead of negative.

title: Incorrect normal force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the friction force on the incline incorrectly uses mg instead of mg cos(37°).
